cases.question: 华东刹车系统 2026Q2 环比下降金额最大的产品是什么，下降金额是多少？
cases.gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_name, SUM(s.sales_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.sale_date>=DATE '2026-04-01' AND s.sale_date<DATE '2026-07-01') q2, SUM(s.sales_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.sale_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sale_date<DATE '2026-04-01') q1 FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=s.region_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND p.category='刹车系统' GROUP BY p.product_name) SELECT product_name, q1-q2 decline_amount FROM q ORDER BY decline_amount DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: 华东刹车系统 2026Q2 销售下降主要来自哪个渠道？给出该渠道下降金额和贡献率。
cases.gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT s.channel, SUM(s.sales_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.sale_date>=DATE '2026-04-01' AND s.sale_date<DATE '2026-07-01') q2, SUM(s.sales_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.sale_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sale_date<DATE '2026-04-01') q1 FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=s.region_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND p.category='刹车系统' GROUP BY s.channel) SELECT channel,q1-q2 FROM q ORDER BY q1-q2 DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: 华东刹车系统 2026Q2 相比 Q1 下降金额最大的 A 级客户是谁？下降了多少？
cases.gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(s.sales_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.sale_date>=DATE '2026-04-01' AND s.sale_date<DATE '2026-07-01') q2, SUM(s.sales_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.sale_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sale_date<DATE '2026-04-01') q1 FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=s.region_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id=s.product_id JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND p.category='刹车系统' AND c.customer_level='A' GROUP BY c.customer_name) SELECT customer_name,q1-q2 FROM q ORDER BY q1-q2 DESC LIMIT 1;
